description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing and aggregating network device statistics from /proc/net/dev in Linux systems, specifically for use within the Prometheus monitoring project.

classes.name: NetDevLine
classes.description: Represents a single line of network device statistics parsed from /proc/net/dev.

methods.name: NetDev()
methods.description: Returns kernel/system network device statistics from /proc/net/dev.

methods.name: NetDev()
methods.description: Returns kernel/system network device statistics from /proc/[pid]/net/dev.

methods.name: newNetDev
methods.description: Creates a NetDev object from the contents of the specified file.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line from /proc/net/dev into a NetDevLine object.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Aggregates network statistics across all interfaces into a single NetDevLine.
